title: 1 YEAR RUSH Begins
description: The preparation year begins. A personal commitment to push beyond my comfort zone, strengthen my cybersecurity knowledge, gain practical experience and pursue professional certifications before internship.

title: Perwira Cyber Industrial Training
description: Selected to participate in the Perwira Cyber Industrial Training, a fully funded training programme for selected participants, conducted in collaboration with NADI Cybersecurity and BlackBerry Cybersecurity Center of Excellence.

title: Selected for UNIRAZAK Student Representative Council (SRC)
description: Selected for the Biro Events and Community Engagement through UNIRAZAK's annual SRC interview process. The Student Representative Council serves as a bridge between students and university management, representing student perspectives and facilitating communication on university matters.

title: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — IGNIS
description: Participated in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 and developed IGNIS, a research platform designed to help users explore, compare and interpret NASA microgravity combustion research.

title: Mini Cyber Awareness Programme
description: Successfully conducted a physical Mini Cyber Awareness session at NADI Semenyih, Selangor, under the Perwira Cyber 2026 programme. Delivered cybersecurity awareness to 10 students aged 12 and below, covering Roblox-related cyber threats, in-game credit scams, phishing links and malicious files. Conducted an interactive quiz, with participants achieving a score of 9/10.
imageAlt: Mini Cyber Awareness Programme at NADI Semenyih

title: NADI Cybersecurity Success Story
description: Selected as a NADI Cybersecurity programme success story and invited to NEXSEC 2026 to share my journey, skills and experiences with YBM Dato' Seri Fahmi Fadzil.
imageAlt: Sharing my NADI Cybersecurity journey with YBM Dato' Seri Fahmi Fadzil at NEXSEC 2026

title: Internship Preparation Goal
description: Targeting my internship period. The objective is to enter the industry with stronger technical skills, practical experience, professional certifications and a portfolio of meaningful work.
